facts.fact: The terms of reference say births in Djibouti city are entered into the SIGEC by five maternity antennas and issued by three commune centres, in operation since 2011.
The terms of reference say civil-status events including deaths in Djibouti city are recorded on the software-based SIGEC, in use since 2011, and the central centre issues death extracts.

systems.tiers: central civil-status centre, 3 commune centres, 5 maternity antennas
